# C. Sloan Lewis | Your Virtual Writing Coach

> A virtual writing coach and speculative fiction author offering personalized coaching, manuscript editing, and craft tutorials for aspiring writers.

C. Sloan Lewis provides comprehensive writing services focused on character development, worldbuilding, and narrative technique for fiction writers. The site features video tutorials, blog content, and one-on-one coaching to help writers overcome common craft challenges and complete their manuscripts.

- [Coaching & Editing Services](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/coaching-editing-services): Main services page for speculative fiction coaching and manuscript editing.

## Character Writing Tutorials

- [What Characters Want, What Stops Them, Why It Matters (GMC Demystified)](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2025/11/09/what-characters-want-what-stops-them-why-it-matters-gmc-demystified-new-yt-video): Tutorial demystifying Goal-Motivation-Conflict framework for character writing.
- [From Flat to Fantastic: Crafting a Character Arc That Hits](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2025/11/15/from-flat-to-fantastic-crafting-a-character-arc-that-hits-yt-video): Tutorial on developing compelling character arcs and transformations.
- [Character Chemistry: Writing Believable Relationships](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2025/12/13/character-chemistry-writing-believable-relationships-yt-video): Guide on crafting authentic character relationships and dynamics.
- [Dialogue That Breathes: Giving Your Characters Their Own Voice](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2025/11/22/dialogue-that-breathes-giving-your-characters-their-own-voice-yt-video): Guide on writing distinctive character dialogue and voice.

## Worldbuilding & Narrative Technique

- [The Rulebook of Your World: How to Keep Your Fiction Believable](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2026/02/10/the-rulebook-of-your-world-how-to-keep-your-fiction-believable-yt-video): Guide on worldbuilding consistency and creating believable fictional rules.
- [Setting Shapes Everything: Character, Conflict, Theme](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2026/02/09/setting-shapes-everything-character-conflict-theme-yt-video): Tutorial on using setting as a character to shape narrative elements.
- [Backstory Without the Info Dump: A Balancing Act](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2025/12/03/backstory-without-the-info-dump-a-balancing-act-yt-video): Tutorial on revealing backstory and worldbuilding without exposition dumps.

## Blog & Writing Advice

- [Blog Hub](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/blog): Blog hub featuring writing tips, storytelling advice, and craft tutorials.
- [Why Most Writers Quit (And It's Not Because They're Bad at Writing)](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2026/02/11/why-most-writers-quit-and-its-not-because-theyre-bad-at-writing-yt-video): Video about writer motivation and overcoming self-doubt and burnout.
- [From Debut to Revised: Why I Chose to Rewrite My First Book](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2026/02/09/from-debut-to-revised-why-i-chose-to-rewrite-my-first-book-yt-video): Author's personal journey rewriting her debut novel The Soul Child.
- [Halfway Though NovNov – Do It For YOU!](https://authorcsloanlewis.com/2025/11/15/halfway-though-novnov-do-it-for-you): Personal reflection on Novel November writing challenge and motivation.
